page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6r.large is an Arm64-based virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated Ampere Altra processor running at 2.8 GHz. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or a GPU. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate modest performance characteristics. The single-core CPU performance under stress-ng falls in the average category, but multi-core CPU scaling is weak, placing in the bottom 25 percent. Memory bandwidth is a notable bottleneck, with cached small-block read speeds and uncached large-block write speeds scoring in the poor and weak categories respectively. Cryptographic and physics processing benchmarks also rank in the bottom 10 percent, reflecting the entry-level nature of this hardware configuration.

Given its dedicated Arm64 cores and low resource density, the ecs.g6r.large offers a highly cost-efficient entry point for lightweight, non-intensive applications. It is suitable for basic web serving, development environments, lightweight Redis caching, and simple text processing workloads that do not require high memory bandwidth or intensive multi-threaded compute.

This resource profile makes the instance a cost-efficient option for lightweight workloads.
